fact_source_merge_policy.multi_end_entry_policy: desktop and web-ui remain operator/control entries; PWA/RN are mobile companion entries over the same projection chain; entry-core exposes navigation/readiness metadata only and does not create another fact authority
fact_source_merge_policy.projection_bootstrap_policy: PWA and RN must bootstrap Gateway before changes; synced cards/spans become explicit local projection only. Empty/unreachable Gateway cannot mark context projection production-ready.
fact_source_merge_policy.device_state_writeback_policy: Mobile may report appliedRevision/localDbVersion/storageUsage to Gateway for sync health and audit. It must not upload local ContextCards/EvidenceSpans as canonical facts through deviceState.
fact_source_merge_policy.release_rollback_policy: Rollback proof is local artifact/readback/steps evidence only. It does not publish, deploy, or mutate external release channels without a separate authority gate.

lark_task_execution_policy.primary_goal: Advance Mobile Offline Avatar Travel through evidence-backed local/mobile implementation slices while preserving Hermes as canonical authority.
lark_task_execution_policy.closeout_rule: No MOAT task closes without task-bound evidence, regression verification, rollback/degradation boundary, and explicit authority for external release/device/cloud side effects.

lark_evidence_policy.evidence_storage: Use project evidence/progress ledger and task frontmatter/body proof links; do not store raw secrets, coordinates, screenshots as memory.

backend_contract_policy.contract_scope: Hermes/Brain canonical facts, ContextCard exporter/cache, Pocket Gateway projection APIs, mobile deviceState/TripState/draft/handoff queues, and local fallback runtime.
backend_contract_policy.schema_rule: Mobile changes must be additive or explicitly migrated; Gateway/deviceState accepts health/projection metadata only and must not allow mobile to write canonical facts/memory/tasks offline.
backend_contract_policy.compatibility_rule: Hermes remains canonical; PWA/RN local projection must fail closed to draft/offline mode when Gateway or projection bootstrap is unavailable.
backend_contract_policy.side_effect_boundary: No deploy, push, TestFlight/App Store/MDM release, cloud write-back, microphone/background-location default, or credential action without separate authority.

required_checks: workspace npm test or focused affected package tests
npm run production:verify when mobile/Gateway release surfaces change
RN/PWA simulator/browser smoke when UI/navigation changes
blocked_closeout_conditions: external release/device install claimed without evidence

semantic_control_plane_strategy.enforcement: warn_only_profile_contract; lifecycle proof gates remain authoritative

platform_expansion.positioning: Expand from mobile-offline-avatar-travel into Hermes Pocket Mobile Platform with travel as first vertical/plugin.
core_capabilities: voice/asr lane gated by explicit permissions

verticals.future_verticals: proposal only until PRD/evidence/task gates exist

non_goals: do not make mobile a canonical fact source
do not upload raw coordinates/screenshots as memory
do not perform external side effects offline
do not claim TestFlight/App Store/MDM/release without separate evidence and authorization
next_safe_slices: platform SSOT/PRD rename and architecture map
active taskpool drain excluding work projects
live Gateway projection and RN/PWA readback refresh
device/simulator UI evidence refresh when permitted
